最后一周不是再背一遍部件清单，而是完成三个可交付的小任务。沿用 Week 10: The final week is not another list of components to memorize. Complete three small deliverable tasks using the same Week 10 MiniGPT class. The mechanism demonstration and independent-document experiment have explicitly different data, configurations and checkpoint formats.
运行五词演示，记录一个输入、目标、表示、logits、loss、梯度、更新与新增: Run the five-token demonstration and record an input, target, representation, logits, loss, gradient, update and newly generated token.
运行 week12_generalization.py，用随包提供的原创小文档训: Run week12_generalization.py to train and validate on the bundled original short documents. Save actual CSV logs, curves and generated samples.
先写预期，再只改变学习率、head 数或层数中的一项；保持其余数据和评估不变。: Write a prediction first, then change just learning rate, head count or layer count while keeping data and evaluation fixed.
解释何时只是流程正确、何时学到训练数据、何时才有独立验证证据。: Distinguish a correct pipeline, learning the training data and evidence from independent validation.
所有运行结果必须由实际命令产生。新实验不会预置“训练成功”的日志或曲线；没有改善: Every reported result must come from an actual command. The experiment does not ship invented success logs or curves. Record lack of improvement honestly too. By the end, trace a prompt to one new token and explain the limits of tiny data and short context.
建议阅读、手算、改代码交替进行，每个单元可拆成几次完成。章节编号保留用于旧链接和: Alternate reading, hand calculation and code changes. Each unit can take several sessions. Section numbers remain stable for old links and references; follow the page from top to bottom rather than jumping around to restore numerical order.
Week 12 核心目标：一条可追踪的完整链路: Week 12 Goal: One Complete, Traceable Pipeline
前十一周分别解释了零件；如果不能从原始文字一路指出当前 tensor、owner: The first eleven weeks explained the components. To identify learning, measurement, saving or generation, follow raw text through the current tensor, its owner, shape and state changes.
建立唯一的固定例子，避免每节换数字造成接口错觉。: Use one fixed example so changing numbers do not create misleading interfaces.
明确 supervised training 在 cross-entropy 汇: Locate supervised training's scalar objective at cross entropy and the start of inference at target-free final-position logits.
直白地说，MiniGPT 是一个条件分数函数，training controll: MiniGPT computes conditional scores; the training controller turns errors into updates. The fixed English trace uses mini-gpt-v1: [you, like, AI, study, we] at IDs 0..4; B=3, N=3, T=2, C=4, H=2, d_head=2, V=5, n_layer=2. General APIs allow other positive B values, but this training example fixes B=3.
训练评分所有六个位置；generation 每轮只消费当前最后位置: Training scores all six positions; each generation round uses only the current final position.
固定训练主线从离散 ID 到三维 logits，再聚合成 rank-0 scal: The fixed training path goes from discrete IDs to three-dimensional logits, then aggregates into a rank-0 scalar loss.
Checkpoint 保存或恢复 state，本身不是一次 learning u: A checkpoint saves or restores state; it is not a learning update.
Generation 没有 training targets，也不调用 back: Generation has no training targets and calls neither backward nor optimizer.step.
Token IDs 是 Vocabulary addresses，不具有数值距离: Token IDs are vocabulary addresses; their numerical differences are not semantic distances.
Supervised training 在哪个对象上第一次成为一个 scalar: Where does supervised training first produce a scalar objective?
当 logits [6,5] 与 targets [6] 进入 cross-en: When logits [6,5] and targets [6] enter cross entropy and produce loss [].
把 tokenizer、模型、训练循环与 checkpoint 都塞进匿名大脚本: A large script mixing tokenizer, model, training loop and checkpoints makes it hard to identify who owns and changes state when something fails.
沿模块边界复用 Week 10/11 的稳定实现。: Reuse Week 10/11's stable implementation across clear module boundaries.
区分 model parameters、optimizer state、tran: Separate model parameters, optimizer state, transient activations and persisted checkpoints.
本周不另起配置类名，也不定义第二套 MiniGPT。: This week does not introduce another configuration class or a second MiniGPT.
Model parameters 属于 MiniGPT；AdamW moment: MiniGPT owns model parameters. The training lifecycle owns AdamW moments and completed_updates.
blocks 必须是 nn.ModuleList，成员仍叫 ln1、attent: Keep blocks in nn.ModuleList with members ln1, attention, ln2 and feed_forward. Attention keeps qkv, output_projection and causal_mask. These names preserve the namespace used by parameters(), state_dict() and Week 10 checkpoints.
520 参数、输入输出 shape、因果检查: 520 parameters, input/output shapes and a causality check
可导入的训练/验证/恢复/生成函数: Importable training, evaluation, resume and generation functions
100 次更新、前后概率、checkpoint 恢复一致、生成文本: 100 updates, before/after probabilities, matching checkpoint restoration and generated text
数值及行为检查的结果，不是语言质量评测: Numerical/behavioral checks, not a language-quality benchmark
先在 course_examples 目录运行 python week12_en: Start with python week12_end_to_end.py in the English course_examples directory. It writes mini-gpt-training.pt in the current directory and uses the three fixed sentences, with no corpus download. See that package's README.md for dependencies, environment creation and exercise order.
普通 Python list 不会像 ModuleList 一样注册子模块。: An ordinary Python list does not register child modules like ModuleList.
不能只凭 tensor shapes 猜 tokenizer meanings。: Tensor shapes alone do not establish tokenizer meanings.
不要把旧缩写 proj、ln_1、attn、ln_f 混入 canonical: Do not mix older abbreviations proj, ln_1, attn or ln_f into the canonical namespace.
MiniGPT.forward；它委托两个 registered blocks: MiniGPT.forward, which delegates contextual transformations to two registered blocks.
随机输出看起来像文字，也可能掩盖错位 targets、非法 IDs、断开的 gr: Random output can resemble text while hiding misaligned targets, invalid IDs, disconnected gradients or missing updates.
在讨论质量前验证每个接口和一次真实 state change。: Verify every interface and one real state change before discussing quality.
把 ln(5) 当作均匀五分类参考，而不是承诺某次初始化的实测值。: Use ln(5) as the uniform five-class reference, not a promised measured initialization value.
先打印三条 raw IDs 和六道题，再验证 dtype、device、shap: Print the three raw ID sequences and six questions, then inspect dtype, device, shapes, finite loss, gradients and parameter changes.
五个候选等概率时的 mean NLL reference；随机初始 loss 可: Mean NLL for five equally probable candidates. Random initial loss may be nearby but need not equal it.
至少一个 parameter value 改变，count=1: At least one parameter value changes; count=1
Shape 正确不证明 label semantics 或 causality: Correct shapes do not prove correct labels or causality.
某一 embedding row 不变不证明整个 update 失败。: One unchanged embedding row does not establish that the whole update failed.
不要用一次生成样本替代 pipeline assertions。: One generated sample is not a substitute for pipeline checks.
问“文字是否好”之前至少先核对什么？: What should you inspect before asking whether the text is good?
ID/shift、dtype/device、shapes、finite loss: IDs/shift, dtype/device, shapes, finite loss/gradients, optimizer binding and an actual parameter update.
3. 从文字开始：冻结 Tokenizer 才有稳定地址: 3. Start with Text: Freeze the Tokenizer for Stable Addresses
用户输入是文字，而 embedding 只接受整数地址；若 mapping 在训: Users supply text, but embeddings need integer addresses. If the mapping drifts between training and restoration, the same row suddenly names another token.
解释 tokenizer 的意义：定义离散单位与稳定 ID 协议。: Explain tokenization as defining discrete units and a stable ID protocol.
把 frozen encoding 与模型学习 contextual repre: Separate frozen encoding from the model's learning of contextual representations.
本教学 tokenizer 仅按空格切分已知词；它没有 specials、PAD: This teaching tokenizer splits known words on whitespace. It has no specials, PAD or UNK.
\\operatorname{encode}(\\text{我 喜欢 AI})=: \operatorname{encode}(\text{you like AI})=[0,1,2]\in\mathbb N^3,\qquad X_{\mathrm{raw}}\in\mathbb N^{B\times N}=\mathbb N^{3\times3}
三条等长句子编码后堆成 raw IDs [3,3]。: Encode the three equal-length sentences and stack them into raw IDs [3,3].
Tokenizer 只决定“切成什么、编号是什么”；embedding 与 bl: The tokenizer decides pieces and IDs. Embeddings and blocks learn continuous representations during training. ID 4 is not a quantity or a meaning greater than ID 0; it is simply the fifth vocabulary row, naming we in this edition.
不能把 Week 9 的 w09-readable-v1（V=11、T=4）ID: Do not pass Week 9's w09-readable-v1 IDs (V=11,T=4) to MiniGPT with V=5 and block_size=2.
新增 token 必须同步改变 ordered mapping、vocab_si: Adding a token requires coordinated changes to the ordered mapping, vocab_size, embeddings, output head and checkpoint identity.
Tokenizer 不等于 semantic encoder。: A tokenizer is not a semantic encoder.
把新 token 加入词表时，哪些接口必须一起变化？: Which interfaces must change together when adding a token?
Frozen mapping、vocab_size、token embeddin: The frozen mapping, vocab_size, token-embedding rows, output-head candidates and compatible checkpoint identity.
4. Training Batch：一行文字变成两道监督题: 4. Training Batch: One Sentence Becomes Two Supervised Questions
Raw sequence 只记录顺序；next-token training 还: A raw sequence records order. Next-token training additionally needs an answer aligned with each context.
用 one-position shift 建立 teacher-forced i: Use a one-position shift to create teacher-forced inputs/targets.
显示一个 forward 为什么同时评分六个 positions。: Show why one forward scores six positions at once.
raw IDs 用左两列作 inputs、右两列作 targets。Teache: Use the left two columns of raw IDs as inputs and the right two as targets. Teacher forcing supplies real prefixes, not tokens just sampled by the model.
每个 target 正好是同一 raw row 中对应 input positi: Each target is exactly the next ID after its aligned input position in the same raw row.
b=0,t=0 与 b=2,t=0 的 causal context 都只有 [: b=0,t=0 and b=2,t=0 both see only [you], but their targets are like and study. This genuine data conflict explains why fixed-batch loss cannot approach zero.
targets=inputs 会变成复制当前 token，而不是预测下一个 to: targets=inputs teaches copying the current token, not predicting the next one.
本课 cross-entropy targets 使用 integer clas: This course uses integer class IDs for CE targets; do not mix them with the separate floating-point probability-target interface.
Training 评分所有 B×T=6 个 positions，不能只取最后位置: Training scores all B×T=6 positions, not just final positions.
第三行 input 学习 的 target 是什么？: What is the target for study in the third input row?
5. Embedding Lookup：离散地址变成四个可学习 Features: 5. Embedding Lookup: Turn Discrete Addresses into Four Learnable Features
把 ID 当普通数字会错误暗示猫=4 比我=0“大”；模型需要每个类别自己的可学: Treating IDs as ordinary quantities falsely suggests we=4 is “larger” than you=0. Each category needs its own learnable vector, and the model also needs position information.
展示 token row lookup 与 position row looku: Distinguish token-row lookup from position-row lookup.
解释 [T,C] position tensor 如何沿 B broadcast: Explain how positions [T,C] broadcast across B to match token rows [B,T,C].
token_embedding 选 row，position_embedding: token_embedding selects a token row; position_embedding selects a position row. Their sum enters the block.
模型学习的 features，不是人工命名属性: Learned features, not manually named attributes
位置 rows [2,4] 在 batch axis 上广播，与每个 seque: Position rows [2,4] broadcast across the batch axis and align with each sequence's token rows.
Position IDs 与 token IDs 是两套 lookup addr: Position IDs and token IDs address different lookup tables.
Embedding 尚未跨 positions 混合信息。: Embedding lookup has not yet mixed information across positions.
Addition 要求最后的 C=4 对齐；它不是 concatenation。: Addition requires matching C=4 widths; it is not concatenation.
[2,4] 沿 batch axis 广播成逻辑上的 [3,2,4]。: [2,4] broadcasts across the batch axis, behaving as [3,2,4] for the addition.
6. Transformer Block：跨位置读取，再逐位置变换: 6. Transformer Block: Read Across Positions, Then Transform Each Position
独立 embedding 无法让第二个“喜欢”的表示因前面是“我”或“猫”而不同: Independent embeddings cannot make the representation of like differ because its preceding token was you or we.
解释 pre-norm Attention 与 FFN 的不同用途。: Explain the different roles of Pre-Norm attention and the FFN.
让两个 residual additions 都保持 [B,T,C] 不变。: Keep [B,T,C] unchanged through both residual additions.
两个 canonical blocks 依次处理同一个 [3,2,4] 表示；A: Two canonical blocks process representations [3,2,4] in sequence. Attention mixes across permitted T positions; the FFN mixes C channels separately at each position.
Pre-norm 先归一化 sublayer input；residual 把: Pre-Norm normalizes the sublayer input. The residual adds the sublayer's output back to the original path.
Residual 是逐元素 addition，不是 concatenation。: A residual is elementwise addition, not concatenation.
FFN 不负责跨 token positions 读取。: The FFN does not directly read across token positions.
Causal mask 必须阻止当前位置读取右侧 target。: The causal mask must prevent a query from reading its target to the right.
哪个 sublayer 让位置 1 能读取位置 0？: Which sublayer lets position 1 read position 0?
7. Q/K/V Shape Trace：把上下文查询摊成矩阵: 7. Trace Q/K/V Shapes: Make Context Queries Concrete Matrices
只背 Q、K、V 名字，仍无法知道 score matrix 的两条 T 轴如何: Knowing the names Q, K and V is not enough. Identify how the score matrix's two T axes arise and which side the mask hides.
从 [3,2,4] 追踪 combined QKV、head split、sco: Trace [3,2,4] through combined QKV, head splitting, scores, weights and merged values.
给 query rows 与 key columns 明确命名。: Explicitly name query rows and key columns.
Query 表示目的位置在找什么，Key 表示来源位置可匹配什么，Value 表: Query describes what the destination position seeks; Key describes how a source position matches; Value contains what is brought back.
最后两轴是 destination query positions × sour: The final two axes are destination query positions × source key positions. Scale by dividing by √2.
先把未来 key scores 设为负无穷，再沿 key axis 做 Soft: Set future-key scores to negative infinity, apply Softmax along the key axis, then aggregate Values.
Query row 0 只能读 key column 0；query row 1: Query row 0 may read only key column 0; query row 1 may read columns 0 and 1. Each batch row and head has its own [2,2] score matrix.
K 的 transpose 只交换最后两个 T/d_head axes。: K's transpose swaps only its final T/d_head axes.
一个 batch example 的一个 head 有多大的 score mat: What is the score-matrix shape for one head of one example?
8. LM Head：每个位置给五个候选打分: 8. LM Head: Score Five Candidates at Every Position
Contextual features 的最后一维是 C=4，不是可直接解释的: Contextual features have final dimension C=4, not directly interpretable token probabilities.
用 final_norm 与 bias-free LM head 把 C=4 映: Use final_norm and a bias-free output head to map C=4 to V=5.
明确 logits 是 raw scores，候选顺序来自 frozen tok: Logits are raw scores; candidate order comes from the frozen tokenizer.
两个 blocks 后仍是 [3,2,4]；final_norm 保持 shap: After two blocks, shape is still [3,2,4]. final_norm preserves it, and lm_head produces five scores at each position.
PyTorch Linear 使用五个 output rows 点乘四维表示；c: PyTorch Linear takes a dot product between the four-channel representation and each of five output-weight rows. This canonical head has no bias.
Logits 不是 probabilities；训练 CE 接收 raw log: Logits are not probabilities; training CE takes raw logits.
位置 0 的 row 只看见第一个 input token，不代表整行 cont: The row at position 0 sees only the first input token, not the whole sequence.
不要给 bias-free equation 加不存在的 +b。: Do not add a nonexistent +b to the bias-free equation.
为什么每个 position 恰有五个 logits？: Why are there exactly five logits per position?
V=5；每个 score 对应 frozen ordered vocabular: V=5. Each score corresponds to one next-token candidate in the frozen ordered vocabulary.
9. Cross Entropy：六个预测汇成一个 Scalar Loss: 9. Cross Entropy: Combine Six Predictions into One Scalar Loss
一次 forward 返回六组候选 scores，而 optimizer 需要一: One forward returns six sets of candidate scores. The optimizer needs a differentiable scalar measuring the batch's prediction error.
解释 flatten 只合并 B/T axes，不会删除任何监督题。: Flattening combines B/T axes without deleting any supervised question.
用一个带标签 logit row 手算概率和 NLL，再与 batch mean: Calculate one labeled row's probabilities and NLL, then distinguish it from the batch mean.
logits [3,2,5] reshape 为 [6,5]，targets [: Reshape logits [3,2,5] to [6,5] and targets [3,2] to [6]. Keeping the same row order preserves all six alignments.
Mean cross-entropy 对六个 aligned target lo: Mean cross entropy averages the six aligned target negative log-probabilities.
单位置数学例子，不是训练后的 batch 实测: One-position calculation, not a measured trained-batch result
候选顺序 [我,喜欢,AI,学习,猫]，若 raw logits=[0,2,1,: In candidate order [you,like,AI,study,we], take raw logits=[0,2,1,-1,0] and target=like. Softmax assigns the target approximately 0.592, giving single-position NLL=-ln(0.592)≈0.524.
固定 didactic logits 的单题结果；不是声称模型训练后一定产生这些: A single question with fixed teaching logits; the trained model is not promised to produce these values.
不要在 F.cross_entropy 前先 Softmax。: Do not apply Softmax before F.cross_entropy.
本课硬标签 Targets 是 long class IDs [6]；不改用另一: The hard-label targets here are long class IDs [6], not the separate probability-target interface.
Single-position 0.524 不等于整批 mean loss。: The single-position value 0.524 is not the whole batch's mean loss.
Targets [3,2] flatten 后是什么 shape？: What shape results from flattening targets [3,2]?
[6]，每项是一个 integer class ID。: [6], with one integer class ID per entry.
10. Backward Trace：从一个数回到所有参与参数: 10. Backward Trace: From One Number to Every Participating Parameter
Loss 只是测量；如果不对参数求导，就没有“往哪里改”这条信号。: Loss measures prediction error. Without derivatives with respect to parameters, there is no signal for how to change them.
沿 LM head→final norm→两 blocks→embeddings: Trace the chain rule through output head→final norm→two blocks→embeddings.
区分 backward 写 gradient buffer 与 optimize: Separate backward's gradient writes from optimizer.step's parameter updates.
loss.backward() 反向穿过构建它的 graph，把 derivat: loss.backward() traverses the graph that produced loss and accumulates derivatives in participating parameters' .grad. Parameter values are still unchanged at this point.
optimizer.step() 之后才产生新 parameter values: New parameter values appear after optimizer.step().
Gradients 默认累加；遗漏 zero_grad 会混入旧窗口。: Gradients accumulate by default. Forgetting zero_grad mixes in earlier windows.
loss.item() 是 detached reporting value，不: loss.item() gives a Python reporting value detached from autograd; you cannot backpropagate through it.
Gradient shape 与 parameter shape 对齐，但数值不: A gradient matches its parameter's shape, not its values.
Backward 后、step 前，什么变了？: What changes after backward but before step?
parameter.grad buffers 变了；parameter valu: parameter.grad buffers change. Parameter values and AdamW moments have not yet been updated.
11. Embedding Rows：被查到的行才有直接 Lookup Grad: 11. Embedding Rows: Lookup Gives Direct Gradients to Selected Rows
看到 embedding table [5,4] 容易误以为每一批都会同样更新五: An embedding table [5,4] does not mean every batch gives all five token rows the same update.
把 input usage 与 LM-head target usage 分开。: Separate input lookup usage from output-head target/candidate usage.
准确解释 ID 2 在 untied architecture 中的 direc: Explain ID 2's direct gradient paths in the untied architecture.
inputs 中出现 IDs {0,1,3,4}；ID 2/AI 只出现在 ta: Inputs contain IDs {0,1,3,4}; ID 2/AI appears only in targets. token_embedding and lm_head are untied.
token_embedding row 2 无直接 lookup gradien: No direct lookup gradient for token_embedding row 2; lm_head row 2 participates in target scoring
token row lookup；LM-head row 4 仍作为非目标候选参: Token-row lookup; output-head row 4 also participates as a non-target Softmax candidate
Embedding lookup 对同一 ID 的所有使用位置累加 row gr: Embedding lookup sums row-gradient contributions from every use of an ID. An unselected row has no contribution through this direct lookup path.
“row 2 没有直接 token-embedding lookup gradi: No direct lookup gradient for input-embedding row 2 does not mean AI has no effect on loss. As a target it affects untied output-head gradients and, through logits/loss, the upstream representations that were used.
Gradient 为零，不代表 Step 后参数值一定不动: Zero Gradient Does Not Necessarily Mean an Unchanged Parameter After Step
本 runner 的 nn.Embedding 使用 dense paramet: This runner uses dense nn.Embedding gradients and AdamW with weight_decay=1e-2. ID 2 is not looked up, so its direct lookup contribution in token_embedding.weight.grad[2] is zero. But decoupled weight decay can still scale a nonzero row-2 parameter. After resumption, historical exp_avg/exp_avg_sq may also contribute to an update even when the current row gradient is zero.
可能因 decay；resume 时也可能因历史 moments 而移动: May move through decay, or through historical moments after resumption
不要把 parameter gradient 与 parameter value: Do not confuse a parameter gradient with the parameter value.
不要说 ID 2 对 loss 完全无作用。: Do not say ID 2 has no effect on loss.
不要从 current direct lookup gradient=0 推断: A zero direct lookup gradient does not imply an unchanged post-step row. Inspect decoupled weight decay and optimizer history.
若 weight tying，input/output 共用一个 table，d: With tied weights, lookup and output use the same table and the gradient paths change. This canonical model is explicitly untied.
哪个 ID 未出现在 inputs，却出现在 targets？其直接影响在哪里？: Which ID appears in targets but not inputs, and where does it have a direct effect?
AI/2；token_embedding row 2 的当前 direct lo: AI/2. Its current direct token-embedding lookup gradient is zero, but output-head row 2 receives gradients through classification. The input-embedding row may still move under this runner's AdamW decay of 1e-2; restored moment history can also drive an update.
12. Optimizer Step：读取 Gradient，更新参数与 Ada: 12. Optimizer Step: Read Gradients, Update Parameters and AdamW State
Gradient 给出局部方向，却还需要 learning rate、momen: Gradients give local directions. Learning rate, moments and decay policy determine the actual update; they still need suitable settings for stable behavior.
按 zero→forward→backward→clip→step 顺序解释每种: Explain each state in the order zero→forward→backward→clip→step.
只在 optimizer.step 成功返回后增加 completed_upda: Increment completed_updates only after optimizer.step returns successfully.
AdamW 对每个 canonical parameter 保存 moving: AdamW retains moments/counters for canonical parameters. Week 11's validator also checks a single group with matching parameter identity/order.
AdamW 为每个 parameter element 维护 gradient: AdamW maintains a first moving average m of gradients and a second moving average v of squared gradients for each parameter element.
Early-step bias corrections 抵消从零初始化 mome: Early-step bias corrections compensate for moments initialized at zero.
在 canonical AdamW 默认方向下的简化逐元素直觉：weight d: Simplified elementwise intuition for canonical AdamW's default minimizing direction: independently scale parameters for weight decay, then subtract a bias-corrected adaptive direction. Actual behavior also depends on explicit optimizer options and numerical implementation.
Plain SGD 的基本式是 θ_t=θ_{t-1}−ηg_t；AdamW 不: Plain SGD uses θ_t=θ_{t-1}−ηg_t. AdamW does not directly use raw g_t as its update. Even with a zero current row gradient, (1−ηλ) can change nonzero parameters, and restored m/v history can yield a nonzero adaptive term.
把 zero_grad 放到 backward 后、step 前会擦掉本次 si: zero_grad after backward but before step erases the current signal.
调用 step 两次会重复消费同一批 gradients。: Calling step twice consumes the same gradients twice.
requested loop count 不是 completed_update: Requested loop length is not completed_updates; count successful steps only.
第一行真正改变 model.state_dict() parameter val: Which operation first changes the model.state_dict() parameter values during the training step?
13. 项目 A：固定三句的训练与保存加载: 13. Project A: Train the Three Sentences, Save and Reload
零散 excerpts 容易漏掉 save 后的严格 reload，或继续用内存: Disconnected snippets can omit strict reloading or generate from the old in-memory model after saving, leaving persistence unverified.
展示一个按静态顺序可编译的 Week 12 caller。: Provide one Week 12 caller whose definitions and execution order are explicit.
完成 fixed batch→100 successful updates→ev: Complete fixed batch→100 successful updates→evaluation reference→save→strict resume→matching logits→generation from the restored model.
在 update window 前后运行时观测同一个 labelled cont: Observe five labeled probabilities for the same context before and after training. Do not prefill or promise their values.
下面文件依赖 Week 10 的 mini_gpt_walkthrough.py: The file below imports Week 10's mini_gpt_walkthrough.py and Week 11's week11_training_and_generation.py. It calls their fixed APIs without redefining GPTConfig, MiniGPT, initialization, state-dict names, checkpoint schema or sampling.
# week12_end_to_end.py\n# This file is a:
# week12_end_to_end.py
# This file is a caller. It reuses, rather than redefines, Week 10/11 APIs.
from __future__ import annotations

from pathlib import Path

import torch
from course_data import DEMO_DOCUMENTS, FIVE_WORD_TOKENIZER, configure_console

from mini_gpt_walkthrough import (
    GPTConfig,
    MiniGPT,
    save_mini_gpt_training_checkpoint,
)
from week11_training_and_generation import (
    CANONICAL_ORDERED_TOKENS,
    CANONICAL_TOKENIZER_POLICY,
    CANONICAL_TOKENIZER_VERSION,
    generate_mini_gpt_sampled,
    load_mini_gpt_training_resume,
    train_mini_gpt_step,
    validate_mini_gpt_adamw_completed_updates,
)


RAW_TEXTS = DEMO_DOCUMENTS
EXPECTED_RAW_IDS = (
    (0, 1, 2),  # you like AI
    (4, 1, 0),  # we like you
    (0, 3, 2),  # you study AI
)
FROZEN_STOI = {
    token: token_id
    for token_id, token in enumerate(CANONICAL_ORDERED_TOKENS)
}
assert CANONICAL_ORDERED_TOKENS == FIVE_WORD_TOKENIZER.tokens
assert CANONICAL_TOKENIZER_POLICY == (
    "whitespace-delimited;no-specials;no-pad;no-unk"
)


def encode_mini_gpt_v1(text: str) -> list[int]:
    ids = FIVE_WORD_TOKENIZER.encode(text)
    if not ids:
        raise ValueError("mini-gpt-v1 text must contain a token")
    return ids


def make_fixed_batch(device: torch.device) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
    encoded_rows = [encode_mini_gpt_v1(text) for text in RAW_TEXTS]
    assert tuple(tuple(row) for row in encoded_rows) == EXPECTED_RAW_IDS
    raw = torch.tensor(encoded_rows, dtype=torch.long, device=device)  # [3,3]
    inputs = raw[:, :-1]   # [3,2]
    targets = raw[:, 1:]   # [3,2]
    return inputs, targets


def main() -> None:
    configure_console()
    # One CPU thread reduces scheduling overhead for this tiny teaching model.
    torch.set_num_threads(1)
    seed = 7
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    if torch.cuda.is_available():
        torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(seed)
    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

    model = MiniGPT(GPTConfig()).to(device)
    optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(
        model.parameters(),
        lr=1e-3,
        weight_decay=1e-2,
    )
    inputs, targets = make_fixed_batch(device)
    assert inputs.shape == targets.shape == (3, 2)

    # Observe the labelled [you,like] -> AI row before any update.
    model.eval()
    with torch.no_grad():
        before_logits, _ = model(inputs)
        before_probs = torch.softmax(before_logits[0, 1, :], dim=-1)  # [5]

    initial_parameters = [p.detach().clone() for p in model.parameters()]
    with torch.no_grad():
        _, initial_loss = model(inputs, targets)
    completed_updates = 0
    for _ in range(100):
        loss, grad_norm, completed_updates = train_mini_gpt_step(
            model,
            optimizer,
            inputs,
            targets,
            device,
            completed_updates=completed_updates,
        )
        assert torch.isfinite(loss) and torch.isfinite(grad_norm)
    assert completed_updates == 100
    assert any(not torch.equal(old, new)
               for old, new in zip(initial_parameters, model.parameters()))
    validate_mini_gpt_adamw_completed_updates(
        model,
        optimizer,
        completed_updates,
    )

    model.eval()
    with torch.no_grad():
        reference_logits, reference_loss = model(inputs, targets)
    assert reference_logits.shape == (3, 2, 5)
    assert reference_loss is not None and reference_loss.ndim == 0
    after_probs = torch.softmax(reference_logits[0, 1, :], dim=-1)  # [5]
    print("parameters=", sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters()))
    print("completed_updates=", completed_updates)
    print("same_batch_loss_before=", initial_loss.item())
    print("same_batch_loss_after=", reference_loss.item())
    print("observed context=[you,like], target=AI")
    print("vocabulary_order=", CANONICAL_ORDERED_TOKENS)
    print("before_probs=", before_probs.detach().cpu().tolist())
    print("after_probs=", after_probs.detach().cpu().tolist())

    path = Path("mini-gpt-training.pt")
    save_mini_gpt_training_checkpoint(
        str(path),
        model=model,
        optimizer=optimizer,
        completed_updates=completed_updates,
        ordered_tokens=CANONICAL_ORDERED_TOKENS,
        tokenizer_policy=CANONICAL_TOKENIZER_POLICY,
        tokenizer_version=CANONICAL_TOKENIZER_VERSION,
    )
    restored, restored_optimizer, restored_updates = (
        load_mini_gpt_training_resume(str(path), device=device)
    )
    assert restored_updates == completed_updates
    validate_mini_gpt_adamw_completed_updates(
        restored,
        restored_optimizer,
        restored_updates,
    )

    restored.eval()
    with torch.no_grad():
        restored_logits, _ = restored(inputs)
    torch.testing.assert_close(restored_logits, reference_logits)
    print("checkpoint_round_trip=PASS")

    prompt = torch.tensor(
        [[FROZEN_STOI["you"], FROZEN_STOI["like"]]],
        dtype=torch.long,
        device=device,
    )
    generated_history = generate_mini_gpt_sampled(
        restored,
        prompt,
        max_new_tokens=3,
        temperature=0.8,
        top_k=3,
    )
    assert generated_history.shape == (1, 5)
    print("generated_ids=", generated_history[0].tolist())
    print("generated_text=", " ".join(
        CANONICAL_ORDERED_TOKENS[i] for i in generated_history[0].tolist()))
    print("This demonstrates mechanisms on three fixed sentences, not held-out generalization.")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

15. 为什么朴素生成会重复计算过去: 15. Why Naive Generation Recomputes the Past
每轮把整个 cropped context 再送入模型，会重复算以前 token: Passing the entire cropped context through the model each round recomputes earlier tokens' Q/K/V and block activations.
先维护正确的 full-history/cropped-context 分工，再: Preserve correct history/context responsibilities first, then explain the efficiency limit.
把 context cropping 与 KV caching 区分。: Distinguish context cropping from KV caching.
O(T²) 只是在描述增长速度：一个 head 的 T 个 query 各比较: O(T²) describes growth: one head compares each of T queries with T keys, creating T² scores. Increasing T from 2 to 4 changes four scores into sixteen. It does not mean T² seconds of runtime, nor include all FFN/projection costs.
当 history=[0,1,2]、block_size=2，下一轮只 forw: With history=[0,1,2] and block_size=2, the next forward receives [1,2], but recomputes both positions' activations through both layers.
重算 cropped context 的全部 layers: Recompute all layers for the cropped context
每层 past keys/values + positions: Past keys/values per layer plus position state
更快但需严格管理 cache shape/device/reset: Can be faster, but requires precise cache shapes, devices and reset rules
不裁剪、反复重算不断增长 prefix 时，attention score wo: Without cropping, repeatedly recomputing a growing prefix has roughly cubic cumulative attention-score work. Here block_size=2 bounds each round.
在前缀、位置编号和计算语义一致时，KV cache 可复用过去的 keys/va: A KV cache can reuse past keys/values and preserve predictions within numerical tolerance when prefixes, positions and computation semantics remain consistent. It cannot be inserted directly into this example: after sliding-window cropping, positions restart at zero and retained tokens may have different position representations and visible prefixes. Old cached states are not automatically equivalent. This teaching code recomputes fully; caching is a separate extension.
求和后约 L³，只计分数工作: Summing gives approximately L³ for score work only
本例固定最多看 2 个 token: This example sees at most two tokens
每 head 最多 4 个分数: At most four scores per head
每轮有固定上限，累计随轮数近线性: Fixed per-round bound; cumulative work grows roughly linearly with rounds
Context crop 不是 KV cache。: Context cropping is not a KV cache.
优化不得让 future positions 泄漏进 earlier logit: An optimization must not leak future positions into earlier logits.
为什么 block_size=2 仍有重复计算？: Why is there still repeated computation with block_size=2?
每轮仍重新计算 cropped context 中两个 positions 的: Each round recomputes layer activations for the positions in the cropped context.
